name: Magical Fighter (Combat)
body:
Your versatility allows you to train as a fighter and caster simultaneously.

Prerequisite: 3rd level fighter.

Benefit: When you gain a bonus feat as a fighter, you may select Metamagic Feats or Combat Feats.
